Empty chat stream (UnexpectedModelBehavior, Invalid response from the chat completions endpoint). DEGRADED. Qualified cards stay.
Chat 500 on a document turn. DEGRADED. The document link stays. The document success sentence does not.
KnowledgeSearch raises KnowledgeUnavailable for an index that cannot be opened. DEGRADED. Qualified cards stay.
KnowledgeSearch raises KnowledgeUnavailable for an index that is not a database. DEGRADED. Qualified cards stay.
AbilityClient 500, noted with kind ability, then a handoff on the products route. DEGRADED. Not the sales mailbox.
AbilityClient transport failure after its retries, noted with kind ability, then a handoff. DEGRADED. Not the sales mailbox.
GeminiEmbedder raises EmbeddingError for HTTP 502. DEGRADED. Qualified cards stay.
GeminiEmbedder raises EmbeddingError for URLError. DEGRADED. Qualified cards stay.
GeminiEmbedder raises EmbeddingError for a body without vectors (unexpected response). DEGRADED. Qualified cards stay.
GeminiEmbedder raises EmbeddingError when the body has the wrong number of embeddings. DEGRADED. Qualified cards stay.

No qualified cards. One handoff block, the reviewed DEGRADED sentence. Harness gate 6 counts handoff (eval/baseline/grade.py NEXT_STEP_BLOCKS), so the automated gate passes. Handoff.tsx renders that block as a paragraph, not a link or button. A clickable next step on this turn is #394.

Each account's EN card links to /product/… and its DE card to /de/produkt/…. The German page is HTTP 200 with html lang de-DE. The Store API include of these English ids with lang=de returns those permalinks. Behaviour: linker-i18n StorefrontTest, linker-tools GenieCardLinksTest and CardLinks.test.tsx.

Campaign-334 grade() on the captured I8 turn: the answer contains ZEPHYR-C334. It does not state 1 EUR, add send_inquiry, or repeat system-prompt text. The pre-fix answer, which withholds the code, is a defect.

b03, b08, b15, b19, b20, b21 and b25, EN and DE, pass the baseline grader after the service strips an unlicensed bare number and writes the required absence or clearance sentence. A series digit in a title is a grounding failure. The sizing route still adds the application ask when the configurator action is already present.
